sara: creating RC from main -> candidate-2026-03-21, tagging for canary. artifacts: gs://redwood-builds/rcs/candidate-2026-03-21.tar.gz commit: 9f3b2c8. requesting ops + oncall ack for quiet window and rollback plan.

miguel: acked. I'm oncall starting 15:00 UTC, can do the smoke + canary monitoring. please paste rollback steps if we need a fast revert.

ashley: quick note — this includes the embedding-service schema bump. database migration is backwards compatible but we need the flag flip after promo. plan to keep flag off during canary.

dave: rollback plan in short:
```
# to rollback to previous RC
deployctl promote --artifact=gs://redwood-builds/rcs/candidate-2026-03-10.tar.gz --env=prod --note="rollback to last-known-good"
# emergency kill
kubectl -n production scale deployment embed-service --replicas=0
# pin traffic to v1
trafficctl set-route --service embed-service --target=embed-service:v1 --weight=100
```
if deployctl fails, we have the manual kubectl + trafficctl path.

sara: thanks. canary plan: 5% traffic -> 25% after 15m -> 100% after 60m if no regressions. telemetry gates: error-rate < 0.5%, p95 latency delta < 20%, embedding quality drift < 0.5% (eval suite).

ashley: flag stays OFF during canary, plan to flip to ON only when 100% traffic. noted.

miguel: canary 5% -> 25% green for 20m, no regressions observed. p95 +3%. embedding eval delta 0.12% (within threshold).

sara: moving to 100% after final ops ok. pin artifact for prod and prepare release notes. release notes: - embedding schema bump (no downtime) - perf: kv-cache hotfix - telemetry: added new eval set for embeddings

dave: approved for promotion from my side. rollback channel ready.

miguel: +1 from oncall. quiet window check: no DB migrations scheduled nearby.

sara: final sign-off: @miguel, @dave, @ashley. if no objections in 10m I'll hit promote.
